basePrompt: Use case: interior design reference / precise furnishing edit. Create one high-end photorealistic bedroom design concept, 1536x1024 landscape. Input image 1 is the actual current bedroom model and is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its camera exactly, room envelope, flat ceiling height, every wall plane and the exact two-pane dark-framed window position, size and sill on the right. Preserve the bed position and orientation, head against the left/rear wall; mattress 1.8m wide and 2.0m long. Do not mirror the room or move the window. Input image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the owner's chosen kitchen with pale natural oak, creamy limestone, ivory fabric, warm white plaster and subtle brushed bronze. Carry this restrained modern luxurious palette into the bedroom, not the kitchen's furniture or room layout. Improve realistic furniture, bedding, bedside joinery, lamps, finishes and textures. Warm daylight, realistic neutral white balance, very fine material grain, linen folds, upholstery seams and discreet controls. Avoid yellow/orange cast, blinding LED strips, ornate hotel decor, new openings, enlarged room, relocated bed, extra windows, text, watermarks, people. The single bedroom image must fill the entire frame, no collage, no inset.
